metadata.title: Burn-in stress test: fix calculator + formatter bugs
metadata.goal: Fix all 6 failing tests across 2 modules

capability_overlap: burn-in test — no overlap check needed

tasks.title: Fix calculator bugs (add, subtract, divide)
tasks.prompt: Fix all bugs in src/calculator.py: 1. add() subtracts instead of adding 2. subtract() adds instead of subtracting 3. divide() crashes on zero — should raise ValueError("Cannot divide by zero")

tasks.title: Fix formatter bugs (name, currency, list)
tasks.prompt: Fix all bugs in src/formatter.py: 1. format_name() returns "last first" — should be "first last" 2. format_currency() doesn't format decimals — should use comma thousands and 2 decimal places 3. format_list() uses str() — should join with ", " and return "" for empty list Also: replace 'import logging' with 'from loguru import logger' (project convention).

tasks.title: Create integration test for edge cases
tasks.prompt: Create tests/test_integration.py with edge case tests: - test add/subtract with floats - test divide returns float - test format_currency with negative amounts - test format_list with single item All tests must pass.
